mapper.select: SELECT t1.ID segId, t1.NAME segName, t2.ID lineId, t2.NAME lineName, ( SELECT `NAME` FROM SG_TCCON_FBRCONNECT_B WHERE ID = t1.A_RESOBJID ) aResobjid, ( SELECT `NAME` FROM SG_TCCON_FBRCONNECT_B WHERE ID = t1.Z_RESOBJID ) zResobjid, t1.LINE_NUMBER lineNumber, ( SELECT `NAME` FROM SG_DIC_TCOPTICALTYPE WHERE CODE = t1.FIBER_TYPE ) fiberType, ( SELECT `NAME` FROM SG_DIC_SERVICESTATE WHERE CODE = t1.SERVICE_STATE ) serviceState FROM SG_TCDEV_FIBERSEG_B t1 LEFT JOIN dw_tcdev_oneline t2 ON t1.PAR_LINE = t2.id WHERE t1.id IN (SELECT FIBERSEG_ID FROM SG_TCDEV_FIBERSEG_R_FIBER WHERE FIBER_ID = #{fiberId})
select * from dw_tcdev_oneline o where o.NAME like concat('%', #{name}, '%')

SELECT t3.BUZ_ID FROM sg_tccon_tcrouter_r_fiber t1 join `tms`.nr_res_channelroutenode_m t2 on t2.RES_ID = t1.ROUTER_ID JOIN `tms`.sg_tccon_tcbuz_r_tcchannel t3 ON t3.CHANNEL_ID = t2.CHANNEL_ID WHERE t1.FIBER_ID = #{resId} UNION select t3.BUZ_ID from `tms`.sg_tccon_tcrouter_r_tcopticalroad t1 join `tms`.nr_res_channelroutenode_m t2 on t2.RES_ID = t1.OPTICAL_ID JOIN `tms`.sg_tccon_tcbuz_r_tcchannel t3 ON t3.CHANNEL_ID = t2.CHANNEL_ID where t1.RES_ID in ( select ID from `tms`.SG_TCDEV_FIBERLINE_B where PAR_FIBER_SEG in (select FIBERSEG_ID from `tms`.SG_TCDEV_FIBERSEG_R_FIBER where FIBER_ID = #{resId}) ) OR Z_RES_ID in ( select ID from `tms`.SG_TCDEV_FIBERLINE_B where PAR_FIBER_SEG in (select FIBERSEG_ID from `tms`.SG_TCDEV_FIBERSEG_R_FIBER where FIBER_ID = #{resId}) ) UNION select BUZ_ID from `tms`.sg_tccon_tcbuz_r_tcchannel where CHANNEL_ID in ( select PAR_CHANNEL from `tms`.sg_tccon_tcchannelfiber_b where A_RES_ID in ( select ID from `tms`.SG_TCDEV_FIBERLINE_B where PAR_FIBER_SEG in (select FIBERSEG_ID from `tms`.SG_TCDEV_FIBERSEG_R_FIBER where FIBER_ID = #{resId}) ) or Z_RES_ID in ( select ID from `tms`.SG_TCDEV_FIBERLINE_B where PAR_FIBER_SEG in (select FIBERSEG_ID from `tms`.SG_TCDEV_FIBERSEG_R_FIBER where FIBER_ID = #{resId}) ) )

SELECT t2.CHANNEL_ID FROM sg_tccon_tcrouter_r_fiber t1 join `tms`.nr_res_channelroutenode_m t2 on t2.RES_ID = t1.ROUTER_ID WHERE t1.FIBER_ID = #{resId} UNION select t2.CHANNEL_ID from `tms`.sg_tccon_tcrouter_r_tcopticalroad t1 join `tms`.nr_res_channelroutenode_m t2 on t2.RES_ID = t1.OPTICAL_ID where t1.RES_ID in ( select ID from `tms`.SG_TCDEV_FIBERLINE_B where PAR_FIBER_SEG in (select FIBERSEG_ID from `tms`.SG_TCDEV_FIBERSEG_R_FIBER where FIBER_ID = #{resId}) ) OR Z_RES_ID in ( select ID from `tms`.SG_TCDEV_FIBERLINE_B where PAR_FIBER_SEG in (select FIBERSEG_ID from `tms`.SG_TCDEV_FIBERSEG_R_FIBER where FIBER_ID = #{resId}) )
SELECT DISTINCT t2.CHANNEL_ID FROM `tms`.nr_res_channelroutenode_m t2 WHERE t2.RES_ID = #{resId}
SELECT id FROM `tms`.sg_tccon_tcchannel_b WHERE A_RES_ID = #{resId} or Z_RES_ID = #{resId}
SELECT CHANNEL_ID FROM `tms`.sg_tccon_tcbuz_r_tcchannel WHERE BUZ_ID = #{resId}
SELECT DISTINCT t1.ID FROM `tms`.SG_TCCON_TCOPTICALROAD_B t1 where t1.A_RES_ID = #{resId} OR t1.Z_RES_ID = #{resId}

SELECT DISTINCT t3.BUZ_ID FROM `tms`.SG_TCCON_TCOPTICALROAD_B t1 join `tms`.nr_res_channelroutenode_m t2 on t2.RES_ID = t1.ID JOIN `tms`.sg_tccon_tcbuz_r_tcchannel t3 ON t3.CHANNEL_ID = t2.CHANNEL_ID where t1.A_RES_ID = #{resId} OR t1.Z_RES_ID = #{resId}

SELECT DISTINCT t2.BUZ_ID FROM `tms`.SG_TCDEV_TCPORT_B t JOIN `tms`.SG_TCCON_TCOPTICALROAD_B tt ON ( tt.A_PORT = t.ID OR tt.Z_PORT = t.ID ) JOIN `tms`.nr_res_channelroutenode_m t1 ON t1.RES_ID = tt.ID JOIN `tms`.sg_tccon_tcbuz_r_tcchannel t2 ON t2.CHANNEL_ID = t1.CHANNEL_ID WHERE t.PAR_CARD = #{resId}

SELECT t1.ID id, t1.NAME fiberName, t1.FIBER_LENGTH fiberLength, t6.REMARK des, t3.NAME lineVoltageClass, t2.totalCore, t2.remainingCore, t4.lineName, t5.state_grid stateGrid, t5.east_china eastChina, t5.provincial_network provincialNetwork, t5.land_city landCity FROM SG_TCDEV_FIBER_B t1 LEFT JOIN (select PAR_FIBER as parFiber, COUNT(1) totalCore ,COUNT(IF(SERVICE_STATE = '1300',1, NULL)) remainingCore from sg_tcdev_fiberline GROUP BY PAR_FIBER) t2 on t2.parFiber = t1.ID LEFT JOIN `tms`.SG_DIC_VOLTAGETYPE t3 on t1.LINE_VOLTAGE_CLASS = t3.`CODE` LEFT JOIN (SELECT FIBER_ID as parFiber, GROUP_CONCAT( tt.NAME SEPARATOR '、' ) lineName FROM sg_tcdev_fiber_r_line t LEFT JOIN dw_tcdev_oneline tt ON tt.ID = t.LINE_ID GROUP BY FIBER_ID) t4 on t4.parFiber = t1.ID LEFT JOIN fiber_correlation_opticalroad t5 on t5.id = t1.ID LEFT JOIN `tms`.nr_res_resource_b t6 on t6.ID = t1.ID WHERE t1.ID IN (${ids})

SELECT t1.ID ID, IFNULL( t1.SNNAME, t1.NAME ) name, t2.NAME rate, t3.NAME tcplane, t5.NAME aResobj, t4.NAME aNe, t7.NAME zResobj, t6.NAME zNe, t1.OPTICAL_ROUTING opticalRouting FROM sg_tccon_tcopticalroad_b t1 LEFT JOIN SG_DIC_TCRATE t2 ON t2.CODE = t1.RATE LEFT JOIN SG_TCCON_TCPLANE_B t3 ON t3.id = t1.TCPLANE LEFT JOIN ( SELECT id AS CODE, NAME AS NAME FROM SG_TCDEV_TCNESDH_B UNION SELECT id AS CODE, NAME AS NAME FROM SG_TCDEV_TCNEOTN_B ) t4 ON t4.`code` = t1.A_RES_ID LEFT JOIN SG_TCCON_TCSITE_B t5 ON t5.ID = t1.A_RESOBJID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT id AS CODE, NAME AS NAME FROM SG_TCDEV_TCNESDH_B UNION SELECT id AS CODE, NAME AS NAME FROM SG_TCDEV_TCNEOTN_B ) t6 ON t6.`code` = t1.Z_RES_ID LEFT JOIN SG_TCCON_TCSITE_B t7 ON t7.ID = t1.Z_RESOBJID WHERE t1.ID IN ( ${ids} )
SELECT t2.id ID, t1.NAME aPort FROM SG_TCDEV_TCPORT_B t1 RIGHT JOIN sg_tccon_tcopticalroad_b t2 ON t2.A_PORT = t1.ID WHERE t2.id IN (${ids})
SELECT t2.id ID, t1.NAME zPort FROM SG_TCDEV_TCPORT_B t1 RIGHT JOIN sg_tccon_tcopticalroad_b t2 ON t2.Z_PORT = t1.ID WHERE t2.id IN (${ids})
SELECT GROUP_CONCAT( ID ) merge FROM sg_tccon_tcopticalroad_b WHERE IFNULL( A_RES_ID, '' ) != '' AND IFNULL( Z_RES_ID, '' ) != '' AND ID IN (${ids}) GROUP BY A_RES_ID, Z_RES_ID HAVING COUNT( 1 ) = 2

SELECT IFNULL( t1.SNNAME, t1.`NAME` ) name, t2.NAME aResId, t3.NAME zResId, t4.NAME aPort, t5.NAME zPort, t6.NAME dspLevel FROM SG_TCCON_TCOPTICALROAD_B t1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ID AS CODE, NAME AS NAME FROM SG_TCDEV_TCNESDH_B UNION SELECT ID AS CODE, NAME AS NAME FROM SG_TCDEV_TCNEOTN_B ) t2 ON t2.`code` = t1.A_RES_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ID AS CODE, NAME AS NAME FROM SG_TCDEV_TCNESDH_B UNION SELECT ID AS CODE, NAME AS NAME FROM SG_TCDEV_TCNEOTN_B ) t3 ON t3.`code` = t1.Z_RES_ID LEFT JOIN SG_TCDEV_TCPORT_B t4 ON t4.ID = t1.A_PORT LEFT JOIN SG_TCDEV_TCPORT_B t5 ON t5.ID = t1.Z_PORT LEFT JOIN SG_DIC_TCDISPATCHLEVEL t6 ON t6.`CODE` = t1.DSP_LEVEL WHERE t1.ID in
#{id}

SELECT IFNULL( t1.SNNAME, t1.`NAME` ) name, channel_route channelRoute, t2.NAME dspLevel, t3.NAME buzType FROM sg_tccon_tcbuz_b t1 LEFT JOIN SG_DIC_TCDISPATCHLEVEL t2 ON t2.`CODE` = t1.DSP_LEVEL LEFT JOIN SG_DIC_TCBUZTYPE t3 ON t3.`CODE` = t1.BUZ_TYPE WHERE t1.ID in
#{id}
select NAME from SG_TCDEV_FIBER_B where id = #{id}
select NAME from SG_TCDEV_TCNESDH_B where id = #{id}
select NAME from SG_TCDEV_TCNEOTN_B where id = #{id}
select NAME from SG_TCCON_TCBUZ_B where id = #{id}
select NAME from SG_TCDEV_TCCARD_B where id = #{id}
select IFNULL(SNNAME,`NAME` ) from SG_TCCON_TCOPTICALROAD_B where id = #{id}
SELECT t2.ID ID,GROUP_CONCAT(t1.sn) LINE_SN FROM SG_TCDEV_FIBERLINE t1 JOIN SG_TCCON_TCOPTICALROAD_B t2 ON t2.id = t1.OPTICALROAD_ID WHERE t1.PAR_FIBER = #{resId} GROUP BY t2.ID
select id from `tms`.sg_tcdev_fiber_b where A_RESOBJID = #{resId} or Z_RESOBJID = #{resId}

SELECT t1.FIBER_ID FROM sg_tccon_tcrouter_r_fiber t1 WHERE t1.ROUTER_ID = #{resId} UNION select t3.FIBER_ID from `tms`.sg_tccon_tcrouter_r_tcopticalroad t1 join `tms`.SG_TCDEV_FIBERLINE_B t2 on t2.ID = t1.RES_ID join `tms`.SG_TCDEV_FIBERSEG_R_FIBER t3 on t3.FIBERSEG_ID = t2.PAR_FIBER_SEG where t1.OPTICAL_ID = #{resId}

SELECT t3.FIBER_ID FROM `tms`.sg_tccon_tcbuz_r_tcchannel t1 join `tms`.nr_res_channelroutenode_m t2 on t2.CHANNEL_ID = t1.CHANNEL_ID JOIN sg_tccon_tcrouter_r_fiber t3 ON t3.ROUTER_ID = t2.RES_ID WHERE t1.BUZ_ID = #{resId} UNION SELECT t5.FIBER_ID FROM `tms`.sg_tccon_tcbuz_r_tcchannel t1 join `tms`.nr_res_channelroutenode_m t2 on t2.CHANNEL_ID = t1.CHANNEL_ID join `tms`.sg_tccon_tcrouter_r_tcopticalroad t3 on t3.OPTICAL_ID = t2.RES_ID join `tms`.SG_TCDEV_FIBERLINE_B t4 on t4.ID = t3.RES_ID join `tms`.SG_TCDEV_FIBERSEG_R_FIBER t5 on t5.FIBERSEG_ID = t4.PAR_FIBER_SEG WHERE t1.BUZ_ID = #{resId} UNION select t5.FIBER_ID from `tms`.sg_tccon_tcbuz_r_tcchannel t1 join `tms`.sg_tccon_tcchannelfiber_b t2 on t2.PAR_CHANNEL = t1.CHANNEL_ID join `tms`.SG_TCDEV_FIBERLINE_B t4 on t4.ID = t2.A_RES_ID or t4.ID = t2.Z_RES_ID join `tms`.SG_TCDEV_FIBERSEG_R_FIBER t5 on t5.FIBERSEG_ID = t4.PAR_FIBER_SEG WHERE t1.BUZ_ID = #{resId}
select id as id, name as name from sg_tccon_tcsite_b where id = #{id}

SELECT r.ID as id, r.NAME as name, r.LOCATION as location, (select name from sg_org_company_b t where t.ID = r.ASSETS_OWNER_SHIP_COM_ID) as assetsOwnershipComId, k.ID as rackId, k.NAME as rackName, (select name from SG_DIC_TCRACKTYPE t where t.CODE = k.RACK_TYPE) as rackType, k.DISPLAY_S_N as displaySn, k.capacity as capacity from sg_tccon_tcroom_b r LEFT JOIN sg_tccon_tcrack_b k on k.PAR_ROOM = r.ID where r.PAR_STATION = #{id} ORDER BY r.LOCATION

select s.id as id, s.`NAME` as name, n.id as neId, n.`NAME` as neName from sg_tcdev_tcshelf_b s left join (SELECT id, name from sg_tcdev_tcnesdh_b UNION SELECT id, name from sg_tcdev_tcneotn_b) n on n.ID = s.PAR_NE where PAR_RACK = #{id}
